name: Growlbear the Grand
biography: Noctursi grandis. Once an esteemed wildshaper, now a slime-coated swamp tyrant that inhales prey four at a time and spits them back out as ammunition. The swallybogs of the Hungering Mire serve him out of terror. Habitat: Swamp.

features.name: Leap
features.description: Growlbear's long jump is up to 35 feet and its high jump is up to 20 feet, with or without a running start.

features.name: Keen Sight and Smell
features.description: Growlbear has Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

features.name: Toxic Mucus
features.description: Growlbear is covered in a layer of poisonous slime. Saving Throw: DC 14 Constitution, a creature that hits Growlbear with a melee attack or otherwise comes into direct contact with its skin. Failure: The target is Poisoned for 1 minute. While Poisoned in this way, the target can't benefit from any Resistances or Damage Immunities and can't regain Hit Points.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: Growlbear makes two attacks, using Claw or Noxious Glob in any combination, and uses Inhale.

features.name: Noxious Glob
features.description: Growlbear spits poisonous mucus. If it has a creature swallowed (see Inhale), Growlbear can launch that creature as part of the attack. Ranged Weapon Attack: +8, range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d8) Poison damage, plus 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage if Growlbear launched a creature. Hit or Miss: The launched creature takes 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Inhale (Recharge 5-6)
features.description:
Saving Throw: DC 14 Strength, each Medium or smaller creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target is swallowed by Growlbear (it can have up to four Medium creatures swallowed at a time). A swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside Growlbear, and it takes 5 (2d4) Acid damage at the start of each of Growlbear's turns.

If Growlbear takes 15+ damage in a single instance from a creature inside him, Growlbear must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which fall Prone in the nearest unoccupied space within 10 feet of Growlbear. If Growlbear dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained by him and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

features.name: Lair: Hungering Mire
features.description:
Initiative 20 (loses ties). Additional XP 450.

Regional Traits

Infested Water. Fumes coming off the grub-filled water prevent wounds from closing quickly. Creatures in the lair other than Growlbear can't use Hit Dice to regain Hit Points during a Short Rest.

Shallow Traps. Hazardous traps lie hidden in the muck. A creature that spends 1 hour traveling in the lair or that fails an ability check to navigate the lair is subject to the following effect. Saving Throw: DC 14 Dexterity. Failure: 13 (3d8) Piercing damage.

Lair Actions (The lair can't take the same action two rounds in a row.)

Swallybogs. Two Swallybogs emerge from the muck in unoccupied spaces of the lair's choice within the lair. They are Friendly to Growlbear and take their turns immediately after the lair.

Spring Trap. A trap goes off in the mire. Saving Throw: DC 14 Dexterity, one creature of the lair's choice within the lair. Failure: 13 (3d8) Piercing damage.

Monster Mist. A patch of sickening mist appears within the lair in a 30-foot-radius Sphere until the start of the lair's next turn. The area is Lightly Obscured. Saving Throw: DC 14 Constitution, each creature that starts its turn in the area other than Growlbear or a swallybog. Failure: The target is transformed into an amphibious hybrid. A transformed creature gains a Swim Speed of 15 feet and has Disadvantage on Charisma checks. The transformation lasts until the creature is targeted by a Lesser Restoration spell or similar magic.
